---
title: "Study area map"
output: html_document
---

<!--
Study area map: Singapore subzones, MRT lines, the CBD and the three regional centres.
Uses the shared map function sg_map() from R/map_theme.R.
Input files (all in data/raw/):
  spatial/MasterPlan2019RailLinelayer.geojson
  spatial/MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson
  spatial/LTAMRTStationExitGEOJSON.geojson
  train_station_codes_2026.csv
Output: outputs/figures/study_area_map.png
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)

source(here("R", "map_theme.R"))     # sg_map(), make_mrt_lines(), map style
source(here("R", "save_fig.R"))      # save_fig()
```

```{r data}
# Singapore subzones (URA Master Plan 2019)
m_subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "spatial",
                          "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson")) |>
  st_transform(3414)

# MRT lines: Master Plan rail track, coloured by line using station exits +
# official station codes (same approach as scripts/Train_all.Rmd)
m_rail <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "spatial", "MasterPlan2019RailLinelayer.geojson"))
m_exit <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "spatial", "LTAMRTStationExitGEOJSON.geojson"))

station_codes <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "train_station_codes_2026.csv")) |>
  transmute(stn_code     = str_to_upper(str_squish(stn_code)),
            station_name = str_to_upper(str_squish(mrt_station_english))) |>
  distinct(stn_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

m_station <- m_exit |>
  st_transform(3414) |>
  mutate(station_name = str_to_upper(str_squish(STATION_NA)),
         station_name = str_remove(station_name, " (MRT|LRT) STATION$")) |>
  group_by(station_name) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
  st_centroid()

mrt_lines <- make_mrt_lines(m_rail, station_codes, m_station)

# Subzones of the four centres used in this study
area_center    <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL",
                    "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL",
                    "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong    <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK",
                    "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)")
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines  <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r prepare}
# Which centre each subzone belongs to
sz <- m_subzone |>
  mutate(centre = case_when(
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_center    ~ "CBD",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong    ~ "Jurong East",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands ~ "Woodlands",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines  ~ "Tampines",
    TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
  ),
  # Fill: CBD / regional centre / rest of Singapore
  area = case_when(centre == "CBD" ~ "CBD",
                   !is.na(centre)  ~ "Regional centre",
                   TRUE            ~ "Other"))

# One outline per centre (its subzones dissolved)
centre_outline <- sz |>
  filter(!is.na(centre)) |>
  group_by(centre) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop")

# Label position: a point inside each centre
centre_label_xy <- centre_outline |>
  st_point_on_surface() |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
         y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r map, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
p_study <- sg_map(
  sz, area,
  type         = "discrete",
  values       = c("CBD" = "#f4b6b6", "Regional centre" = "#a6cee3", "Other" = "white"),
  breaks       = c("CBD", "Regional centre"),
  labels       = c("CBD", "Regional centre"),
  legend_title = "Legend",
  mrt_lines    = mrt_lines,
  title        = "Study area",
  caption      = paste("Data: URA Master Plan 2019 subzones; LTA DataMall MRT station",
                       "exits and station codes.\nMRT lines are schematic",
                       "(stations joined in code order).")
) +
  # black outline and name of each centre
  geom_sf(data = centre_outline, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_label(data = centre_label_xy, aes(x = x, y = y, label = centre),
             size = 3, fontface = "bold", fill = "white", label.size = 0,
             label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"), nudge_y = 1800)
p_study

save_fig(p_study, "study_area_map", width = 9, height = 6)
```
